fields.name: File Status
fields.error: references the deleted or unknown field

fields.name: Financial Classification
fields.error: references the deleted or unknown field

fields.name: Budget Type
fields.error: references the deleted or unknown field

fields.name: Net Amount before VAT
fields.formula: field('Requested Amount before VAT') + field('Finance Adjustment before VAT')

fields.name: Non-recoverable VAT
fields.formula: if(field('VAT Treatment') = 'Standard Non-recoverable', field('Net Amount before VAT') * field('VAT Rate %') / 100, 0)

fields.name: Finance Recommendation
fields.formula: round(field('Net Amount before VAT') + field('Non-recoverable VAT'), 2)

fields.name: Finance Variance
fields.formula: field('Finance Recommendation') - field('Requested Amount before VAT')

fields.name: Validation Status
fields.formula: if(field('File Code') = '', '⚠️ File code missing', if(count(field('Budget File')) = 0, '⚠️ Link a budget file', if(field('Fiscal Year') = 0, '⚠️ Fiscal year missing', if(totext(field('Month')) = '', '⚠️ Month missing', if(count(field('Unified Account')) = 0, '⚠️ Unified account missing', if(count(field('Unified Cost Center')) = 0, '⚠️ Cost center missing', if(field('Requested Amount before VAT') = 0, '⚠️ Amount missing', if(totext(field('VAT Treatment')) = '', '⚠️ VAT treatment missing', if(and(field('Finance Adjustment before VAT') != 0, field('Adjustment Reason') = ''), '⚠️ Provide an adjustment reason', if(totext(field('Finance Review Status')) != 'Reviewed', '⚠️ Finance has not reviewed', '✅ Valid for Consolidation'))))))))))

fields.name: Amount Presented to the Board
fields.formula: if(field('Approved Amount') > 0, field('Approved Amount'), field('Finance Recommendation'))
